# hardhat-exposed

Hardhat 3 port of [`hardhat-exposed`](https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/hardhat-exposed), vendored from [OpenZeppelin Contracts](https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-contracts/tree/1f2665e8d52677fd61f8daedc41ca77e1c64259d/hardhat/hardhat-exposed) at commit `1f2665e8d52677fd61f8daedc41ca77e1c64259d`.

The upstream `hardhat-exposed` npm package does not support Hardhat 3. Replace this directory with the npm package once a compatible version is released.

Files are kept unmodified to simplify syncing with upstream. See `LICENSE` for the original copyright notice.
